build_task_template: build a PHYRE task template that places jars, balls, and bars in a physics scene
create_dynamic_objects: create dynamic jars and balls using C.add with scale, position, and angle parameters
add_static_bars: add static bars to the scene at specific angles and positions using C.add
define_task_relationships: define a task goal by setting two bodies to touch using C.update_task and SpatialRelationship
set_solution_metadata: set the solution tier metadata using C.set_meta with SolutionTier.TWO_BALLS
